provenance: Original synthetic exposed development inputs, not holdouts or upstream issue reproductions.
oracle: Declared source-order elements, bond endpoints/orders and parsed finite IEEE-754 Cartesian coordinates in Angstrom; compare coordinate bits including signed zero. No graph-isomorphism, stereo or opaque metadata validation.
